primaryTextChecks.text: Naphtali didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth Anath; but he lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land. Nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh and of Beth Anath became subject to forced labor.

context.text: but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land, for they didn’t drive them out.
The Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill country, for they would not allow them to come down to the valley;
